bio: Located at TAUERN SPA wellness hotel, this chic little contemporary-style restaurant is separate from the hotel but accessible from inside it. Seating is limited to 14 diners, who are served a six-course ingredient-led set menu. With his menu titled Reise durch Salzburg (Journey through Salzburg), ambitious chef Christof Schernthaner showcases regional and seasonal cuisine, highlighting exceptional ingredients such as home-grown woodruff, Lungau Eachtling potatoes and Alpine prawns. Wine pairings are available on request. The service is cordial – the chef serves and explains his dishes personally. N.B. Advance reservation is advised (before 11am on the day)....
